subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public rotation callback add `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` while retaining `attempt` indefinitely, or should this PR begin a formal deprecation lifecycle for `attempt`?
rationale: The code can add the fields mechanically, but only maintainers can choose the long-term compatibility contract for a shipped plugin-facing callback.

options.title: Add fields without deprecation
options.body: Keep `attempt` supported and add the two unambiguous fields as a backward-compatible extension.

options.title: Approve formal deprecation
options.body: Retain the annotation only with an explicit replacement contract, compatibility tests, documentation, and removal plan.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Keep the current PR open or close it until an owner selects the permanent callback naming and lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Add fields without deprecation
recommendation.body: Keep `attempt` supported and add the two unambiguous fields as a backward-compatible extension.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice governs the long-term published agent and plugin authentication API rather than only the local implementation.
